messages.subject: Project ideas needed!
parts:
I've submitted R's organization application.

Google will begin reviewing these applications on Friday, February 14th.

Part of their review process is a review of project ideas posted by the
organization to gauge interest and level of organization.

R's project idea list for this year is here:

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2014

Potential Mentors: please post project ideas as soon as you can!

Potential Students: please contact potential mentors and help!

As always, feel free to contact me or one of the other program admins
with any questions.

Regards,

Brian
